reviews.author: Dipayan Nag
reviews.text: Bukhara totally lived up to the hype! I had three foreign nationals with me, and I had created quite a bit of hype beforehand—showing them videos, sharing stories, and even pointing out the who's who who have dined here. At one point, I honestly wondered, I hope I haven't overhyped this! But from the moment we entered Bukhara, the experience delivered. The service, the warm hospitality, the way they explain the history and legacy of the restaurant—and then, of course, the four-foot naan! reviews.author: Nakul Sinha
reviews.text: Food was quite average. Not at all worth the hype. It was way too crowded as well. There was mismanagement even though i had pre booked the table.

reviews.author: Abhishek Gupta
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience at Bukhara while celebrating my wife's birthday. The food was excellent, but what truly made the evening special was the exceptional service. A special mention to Vinod, Bharat, Amit, and Thang for their warm hospitality, attentiveness, and personal touch throughout the evening. They made sure everything was taken care of and went out of their way to make my wife's birthday celebration memorable. Thank you to the entire Bukhara team for a fantastic experience. We truly enjoyed the evening and will definitely look forward to coming back!
